title: Dolphin Watch 4 | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents... “Dolphin Watch 4,” your Gulf-front getaway in Seacrest West! Wake up to the sound of waves, sip coffee on the Gulf-front patio and watch dolphins play in the water. With space to sleep 6, this family-friendly retreat blends coastal comfort with beautiful views. Inside, enjoy a welcoming living space, fully equipped kitchen and all the comforts of home. Spend your afternoons relaxing on the patio, preparing dinner on the grill or simply enjoying the Gulf breeze. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Location: Enjoy uninterrupted views of the emerald Gulf waters right from the property.Gulf-Front Patio: Spacious outdoor area with comfortable seating, a charcoal grill and dining space overlooking the water.Stylish Living: Bright, open-concept living area with comfortable furnishings and beautiful Gulf views.Fully Equipped Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, generous counter space and a breakfast bar with seating for 5.Family-Friendly Comfort: Accommodates up to 6 guests with 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms.Close to 30A Attractions: Explore nearby Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill for shopping, dining and entertainment.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Great location, comfortable space, and watching the waves on the patio was magical. Would definitely recommend!" – Rosie T.⭐ "Gorgeous view and perfect for our getaway. Already planning our next trip!" – Mandy J.⭐ "The property’s location was amazing with stunning views. Perfect for a family vacation!" – Rebecca M.*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in the spacious, sunlit living area where panoramic Gulf views create a beautiful backdrop throughout the day. Settle into the comfortable seating for a movie night, enjoy your favorite shows on the flat-screen TV or simply relax while taking in the views of the water.Spacious open-concept layout showcasing panoramic Gulf viewsComfortable seating with plenty of room to relaxHigh-definition flat-screen TV to elevate your entertainment experience*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, generous counter space and everything needed to prepare meals during your stay. The breakfast bar seats five, making it a convenient spot for casual dining or morning coffee. A wet bar provides additional space for preparing drinks and entertaining.Stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceBreakfast bar with seating for 5, plus sofa table for additional seatingOpen-concept layout connecting the kitchen and living areasConvenient wet bar for entertaining and refreshments*** OUTDOOR GULF-FRONT OASIS ***The Gulf-front patio is one of the highlights of "Dolphin Watch 4," offering uninterrupted views of the water and plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors. Start your morning with coffee overlooking the Gulf, spend the afternoon lounging in the sunshine or prepare dinner on the charcoal grill as the evening settles in.Spacious Gulf-front patio with comfortable seating and sun loungersCharcoal grill and outdoor dining areaOutdoor shower for added conveniencePanoramic views of the Gulf*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***"Dolphin Watch 4" comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests across three bedrooms, with two full bathrooms providing plenty of convenience for families and groups.Primary Suite: King-size bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, flat-screen TV and shared access to a hall bathroomTwin Guest Suite: Two Twin beds, shared access to a hall bathroomGuest Bathroom: Single vanity & shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest West, Dolphin Watch 4 provides the perfect base for exploring the area’s top attractions. Stroll through charming boutique shops, savor delicious meals at trendy restaurants, or unwind on the picturesque shores of Alys and Rosemary Beaches—all just moments away. Don’t forget to pick up fresh dinner at Buddy's Seafood Market nearby!Alys Beach: Beautiful white architecture, local restaurants and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach: Boutique shopping, coffee shops, restaurants and a charming Town CenterSeagrove & Seacrest: Local restaurants, seafood markets and casual dining optionsThe Big Chill: Dining, live music and family-friendly entertainment*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
